changes.summary: Automation engine: call nodes run in automation.call child instances with retries, masking and blocked unknown outcomes (Operations.Resolve/Retry); ask nodes with correlation tokens; connector inbound (outbox publish with dedup, webhook handler, poller, collect windows) and loop protection (include_self); human node with quorum, escalation and automation.task.assigned.v1; BuildRunContext with subject.url and run.url; dry run with node DryRun modes and a decision cache, and test node.

Automation editor Tidy v2: columns per trigger, failure lane, children under their ports, orthogonal links, a Tidy button with ⇧⌘L, and a layout that keeps groups arranged by hand; the card target handle moves to the top edge.

pykernel sandbox is opt-in: the zero isolation.Profile is ModeInsecureDisabled, so manager.New no longer fails on hosts without Landlock ABI 6 or CAP_SYS_PTRACE (Granite and ERP failed to start on 0.53.0). Hosts that want confinement set Sandbox: isolation.Profile{Mode: isolation.ModeRequired}. execute still requires a verified sandbox unless InsecureAllowUnconfinedRuntime is set. Breaking: the numeric values of isolation.Mode swapped.
